Name: Realistic Portraits for Vanilla Characters (CP)
Author: lilxxl007
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54133/54133-1792359996-374927615.jpg[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧ Description ✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Content Pack with Realistic Portraits for replacing all 47 vanilla Stardew Valley characters, who have their own portraits in the game - 400px portraits with automatic seasonal, location and work variants, all emotions and face expressions saved. This is an AI-generated portraits with finishing touches in a graphic editor, all coincidences with real people are accidental.[/color][/center]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54133/54133-1792360004-784803211.jpg[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧ Installation instructions ✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]1. Extract [CP] lilxxl007 Realistic Portraits directly into the game's Mods folder.[/color][/left]
[left][color=#D4D4D8]2. Launch the game through SMAPI. Open a conversation and press P until HDP is selected in Portraiture. The selection is saved. If an NPC is pinned to a different set, press O to unpin it, then select HDP. This is a one-time selection of a set. Press I to toggle Portraiture's portrait display style.[/color][/left]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54133/54133-1792360014-626654797.jpg[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧ Main features ✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]This is a complete replacement of all character portraits from the original game (including the bear, goblin, dwarf, etc.). All sheets featuring various emotions, facial expressions, seasonal outfits, and unique attire (such as Maru’s uniform, Joja uniforms, etc.) have been preserved following the set from the original game and replaced.[/color][/center]
[center][line]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54133/54133-1792359986-1954150761.jpg[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][b]✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧ Requirements ✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧[/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI, Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Platonymous?gameId=1303]Platonymous[/url].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]This pack uses Portraiture's built-in HDP mode; prepared against Portraiture 1.12.1-alpha.20240304.[/color][/center]
[center][line]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧ [size=4]Other notes[/size] ✧ ✩ ⋆ ｡ ˚ ⋆ ✩ ✧[/b][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]I’m planning to make realistic portraits for other characters ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]), that do not have restrictions on the use of AI (like Ridgeside's Village team). But right now, I’m not quite sure whether you’ll be interested in this..[/color][/center]
